reasoning_content:
No engine container. The docker-compose build was still running and probably failed. Let me start docker-compose in detached and wait for it.

But wait - the external proxy 502 is likely because the traffic goes through some external proxy (the all-hands.dev stuff). These hosts have DNS pointing to somewhere else. Let me just check if the issue is from external proxy side - the nginx on VPS is fine but needs a container.

Let me check what's listening on 127.0.0.1:3000 and maybe start docker-compose properly.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Kill any existing node first
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pkill -f 'tsx src' 2>&1 || true")

time.sleep(2)

# Check build log
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -20 /tmp/docker-build.log 2>&1")
print("Build:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
